help:
usage: inventag [-h] [--accounts-file ACCOUNTS_FILE] [--accounts-prompt]
                [--cross-account-role CROSS_ACCOUNT_ROLE] [--create-word] [--create-excel]
                [--create-google-docs] [--create-google-sheets]
                [--google-credentials SERVICE_ACCOUNT.json]
                [--google-oauth-client CLIENT_SECRET.json] [--google-folder-id GOOGLE_FOLDER_ID]
                [--google-share-with EMAIL] [--google-share-role {reader,commenter,writer}]
                [--google-share-anyone] [--google-title GOOGLE_TITLE] [--enable-network-analysis]
                [--enable-security-analysis] [--enable-cost-analysis]
                [--fallback-display {auto,always,never}] [--hide-fallback-resources]
                [--finops-checks] [--finops-cost-allocation] [--no-cost-in-snapshot]
                [--s3-bucket S3_BUCKET] [--s3-key-prefix S3_KEY_PREFIX]
                [--s3-encryption {AES256,aws:kms}] [--s3-kms-key-id S3_KMS_KEY_ID]
                [--account-regions ACCOUNT_REGIONS] [--account-services ACCOUNT_SERVICES]
                [--billing-validation | --no-billing-validation] [--account-tags ACCOUNT_TAGS]
                [--max-concurrent-accounts MAX_CONCURRENT_ACCOUNTS] [--concurrency N]
                [--account-processing-timeout ACCOUNT_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT] [--resume]
                [--resume-max-age-hours RESUME_MAX_AGE_HOURS] [--disable-parallel-processing]
                [--service-descriptions SERVICE_DESCRIPTIONS] [--tag-mappings TAG_MAPPINGS]
                [--bom-config BOM_CONFIG] [--validate-config] [--validate-config-only]
                [--word-template PATH] [--excel-template PATH]
                [--print-default-template {word,excel}] [--validate-templates]
                [--output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY] [--enable-state-management]
                [--disable-state-management] [--enable-delta-detection]
                [--disable-delta-detection] [--generate-changelog | --no-generate-changelog]
                [--state-retention-days N] [--state-max-snapshots N] [--per-account-reports]
                [--policy PATH] [--policy-waivers FILE] [--policy-fail-on SEVERITY]
                [--policy-format LIST] [--fail-on-account-error] [--fail-if-empty] [--version]
                [--verbose] [--debug] [--log-file LOG_FILE] [--disable-account-logging]
                [--validate-credentials] [--credential-timeout CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT]
                [--skip-credential-validation] [--enable-production-safety]
                [--disable-production-safety] [--enforce-read-only] [--security-validation]
                [--compliance-standard {general,soc2,pci,hipaa,gdpr}]
                [--risk-threshold {LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL}] [--audit-output AUDIT_OUTPUT]
                [--validate-operations VALIDATE_OPERATIONS [VALIDATE_OPERATIONS ...]]
                [--template NAME|PATH]

InvenTag - Comprehensive AWS Cloud Governance Platform

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             Show the InvenTag version and exit

Account Configuration:
  --accounts-file ACCOUNTS_FILE
                        Path to accounts configuration file (JSON/YAML) containing account
                        credentials and settings
  --accounts-prompt     Interactively prompt for account credentials and configuration
  --cross-account-role CROSS_ACCOUNT_ROLE
                        Role to assume. A full role ARN is assumed directly. A role name
                        (optionally with path) is combined with each account ID from --accounts-
                        file into arn:<partition>:iam::<account>:role/<name>

Output Format Options:
  --create-word         Generate professional Word document BOM report
  --create-excel        Generate comprehensive Excel workbook BOM report
  --create-google-docs  Create the Word report as a Google Doc (needs the Google extra: pip
                        install "inventag-aws[google]")
  --create-google-sheets
                        Create the Excel report as a Google Sheets spreadsheet

Google Sheets and Docs Options:
  --google-credentials SERVICE_ACCOUNT.json
                        Service-account key file. Without it, Application Default Credentials are
                        used
  --google-oauth-client CLIENT_SECRET.json
                        Sign in as yourself in the browser, with this OAuth client file
  --google-folder-id GOOGLE_FOLDER_ID
                        Put the files in this Google Drive folder (it must be shared with the
                        account)
  --google-share-with EMAIL
                        Share the files with this person (repeat for more people)
  --google-share-role {reader,commenter,writer}
                        Access for --google-share-with (default: reader)
  --google-share-anyone
                        Make the files readable by anyone with the link. Off by default
  --google-title GOOGLE_TITLE
                        Title of the Google files (default: InvenTag AWS inventory <date>)

Analysis Options:
  --enable-network-analysis
                        Enable network analysis for VPC, subnets, and network security
  --enable-security-analysis
                        Enable security analysis for security groups, NACLs, and security posture
  --enable-cost-analysis
                        Enable cost analysis and optimization recommendations. The cost trend
                        makes at most 2 Cost Explorer requests (ce:GetCostAndUsage) for each
                        account, with that account's credentials, whatever the number of services,
                        and each retry of a throttled request is one more request; AWS charges for
                        each request. --no-billing-validation is independent of it: the cost
                        analysis still calls Cost Explorer when billing validation is off
  --fallback-display {auto,always,never}
                        Control fallback resource display: 'auto' shows fallback only when no
                        primary resources found for a service (recommended), 'always' shows all
                        fallback resources for maximum visibility, 'never' hides all fallback
  --hide-fallback-resources
                        Legacy option: equivalent to --fallback-display=never (deprecated, use
                        --fallback-display instead)
  --finops-checks       Run six FinOps checks (FIN-001 to FIN-006) on the resources the scan found
                        and add a FinOps sheet to the Excel report. Off by default. The checks
                        make no further AWS call and need no further permission, and their
                        findings do not change the exit code. With --template, no sheet is added:
                        the findings are written to policy_findings_<timestamp>.json
  --finops-cost-allocation
                        Read the last full month's spend from Cost Explorer for each account, with
                        that account's own credentials: by service, by linked account and by each
                        key of the built-in finops-cost-allocation tag policy that is active as a
                        cost allocation tag. Adds a FinOps costs sheet to the Excel report. Off by
                        default. Makes at most 7 Cost Explorer requests per account (AWS charges
                        for each; the SDK's retries of a throttled request add more) and needs
                        ce:ListCostAllocationTags. The amounts are never shown per resource
  --no-cost-in-snapshot
                        With --finops-cost-allocation: keep the cost figures out of the state
                        snapshot. The FinOps costs sheet is still written

S3 Upload Options (CI/CD Integration):
  --s3-bucket S3_BUCKET
                        Upload generated reports to this S3 bucket (server-side encrypted, using
                        the default AWS credentials; needs s3:PutObject). The run fails if any
                        upload fails
  --s3-key-prefix S3_KEY_PREFIX
                        S3 key prefix for organizing uploaded documents (default: bom-reports/)
  --s3-encryption {AES256,aws:kms}
                        S3 server-side encryption method (default: AES256)
  --s3-kms-key-id S3_KMS_KEY_ID
                        KMS key for --s3-encryption aws:kms (default: the AWS managed key aws/s3).
                        Needs --s3-encryption aws:kms

Account-Specific Configuration Overrides:
  --account-regions ACCOUNT_REGIONS
                        Comma-separated list of AWS regions to scan (default: auto-discover all
                        regions)
  --account-services ACCOUNT_SERVICES
                        Comma-separated list of AWS services to keep in the report, matched
                        against the Service column (for example EC2,S3,RDS). Empty means all
                        services
  --billing-validation, --no-billing-validation
                        Use Cost Explorer during discovery to find services that have spend
                        (default: enabled). AWS charges for each Cost Explorer API request; use
                        --no-billing-validation to make no Cost Explorer calls during discovery.
                        --enable-cost-analysis is independent of it and still calls Cost Explorer
  --account-tags ACCOUNT_TAGS
                        JSON string of tag filters to apply across all accounts

Parallel Processing Options:
  --max-concurrent-accounts MAX_CONCURRENT_ACCOUNTS
                        Maximum number of accounts to process concurrently (default: 4)
  --concurrency N       Most AWS requests in flight at once, for the whole run (default: 64). 1
                        sends one request at a time.
  --account-processing-timeout ACCOUNT_PROCESSING_TIMEOUT
                        Timeout in seconds for processing each account (default: 1800)
  --resume              Reuse the saved results of accounts that finished in an earlier run of the
                        same command that did not complete (same accounts, regions, services and
                        filters), and scan only the others. Off by default
  --resume-max-age-hours RESUME_MAX_AGE_HOURS
                        With --resume, reuse saved results only up to this age (default: 24, at
                        most 168)
  --disable-parallel-processing
                        Disable parallel account processing (process accounts sequentially)

Configuration Files:
  --service-descriptions SERVICE_DESCRIPTIONS
                        Path to service descriptions configuration file (YAML/JSON)
  --tag-mappings TAG_MAPPINGS
                        Path to tag mappings configuration file (YAML/JSON)
  --bom-config BOM_CONFIG
                        Path to BOM processing configuration file (YAML/JSON)
  --validate-config     Validate all configuration files and exit (no BOM generation)
  --validate-config-only
                        Only validate specific config files without running full validation

Report Templates:
  --word-template PATH  Template file (YAML or JSON) for the Word report: title, sections,
                        columns, header and footer. Needs --create-word
  --excel-template PATH
                        Template file (YAML or JSON) for the Excel report: sheets, columns, header
                        color, header and footer
  --print-default-template {word,excel}
                        Print the default template for the given format and exit. Redirect the
                        output to a file to start your own template
  --validate-templates  Validate the files given with --word-template and --excel-template and
                        exit (no AWS call)

Output and State Management:
  --output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
                        Directory for output files (default: bom_output)
  --enable-state-management
                        Enable state management for change tracking (default: enabled)
  --disable-state-management
                        Disable state management and change tracking
  --enable-delta-detection
                        Enable delta detection for change analysis (default: enabled)
  --disable-delta-detection
                        Disable delta detection
  --generate-changelog, --no-generate-changelog
                        Generate a changelog for detected changes (default: enabled; use --no-
                        generate-changelog to turn it off)
  --state-retention-days N
                        Delete state snapshots older than N days when a run saves a new one
                        (default 30). Use 0 or none to keep snapshots of any age
  --state-max-snapshots N
                        Keep only the newest N state snapshots (default 100). Use 0 or none to
                        keep every snapshot
  --per-account-reports
                        Write one report for each account (<account-id>_bom_<time>.xlsx) instead
                        of one consolidated report

Policies (governance as code; see 'inventag policy --help'):
  --policy PATH         Check this policy file, policy set or folder on the state snapshot of this
                        run (repeatable). Writes policy_findings_<time>.json next to the reports
                        and a summary on the console. Needs the state snapshot
  --policy-waivers FILE
                        With --policy: a waivers file
  --policy-fail-on SEVERITY
                        With --policy: exit with code 7 when a finding fails at this severity or
                        higher (info, low, medium, high, critical), after codes 5, 6, 3 and 4
  --policy-format LIST  With --policy: the files to write, comma-separated: json, sarif, junit,
                        markdown (default: json)

Exit Codes (opt-in):
  --fail-on-account-error
                        Exit with code 5 when an account could not be scanned or ran out of time
                        (the reports are still written). Without it, such a run exits with 0
                        unless every account failed
  --fail-if-empty       Exit with code 6 when no resources were found or the filters removed all
                        of them. Without it, such a run exits with 0

Logging and Debug Options:
  --verbose, -v         Show each step (INFO). Give it twice (-vv) for debug output, the same as
                        --debug.
  --debug, -d           Show debug output and every AWS request. Secrets are masked; treat the
                        output as sensitive.
  --log-file LOG_FILE   Path to log file for persistent logging
  --disable-account-logging
                        Disable account-specific logging prefixes

Credential Validation:
  --validate-credentials
                        Validate all account credentials before processing and exit
  --credential-timeout CREDENTIAL_TIMEOUT
                        Timeout in seconds for credential validation (default: 30)
  --skip-credential-validation
                        Skip early AWS credential validation (not recommended)

Production Safety and Security:
  --enable-production-safety
                        Accepted for compatibility; the read-only guard is always on
  --disable-production-safety
                        Not supported: exits with an error (the read-only guard cannot be
                        disabled)
  --enforce-read-only   Block every AWS API call that is not read-only (always on): only
                        List/Describe/Get/Head/Lookup/Search/BatchGet operations, minus calls that
                        return secrets or data, are allowed
  --security-validation
                        Accepted for compatibility; same as --enforce-read-only (always on)
  --compliance-standard {general,soc2,pci,hipaa,gdpr}
                        Not implemented yet: exits with an error if given
  --risk-threshold {LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL}
                        Exit with code 4 if security analysis finds a security group rule at or
                        above this risk level (needs --enable-security-analysis)
  --audit-output AUDIT_OUTPUT
                        Write a JSON audit of every AWS API operation the run called (allowed and
                        blocked) to this file
  --validate-operations VALIDATE_OPERATIONS [VALIDATE_OPERATIONS ...]
                        Check service:Operation names (e.g. ec2:DescribeInstances) against the
                        read-only guard and exit (0 if all allowed, 1 otherwise)

Templates:
  Reusable report layouts, tag policies and run settings. See 'inventag templates --help'.

  --template NAME|PATH  Use a template by name or file path. Repeat to combine one report, one
                        tag-policy and one config template, e.g. --template standard-bom
                        --template finops-cost-allocation

Examples:
  # Generate BOM for single account using default credentials
  inventag --create-excel --create-word

  # Multi-account BOM generation from file
  inventag --accounts-file accounts.json --create-excel --s3-bucket my-bucket

  # Interactive multi-account setup
  inventag --accounts-prompt --create-word --create-excel --verbose

  # Assume one role ARN (auto-discovers all regions)
  inventag --cross-account-role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/InvenTagReadOnly

  # Same role name in every account listed in accounts.json
  inventag --accounts-file accounts.json --cross-account-role InvenTagReadOnly

  # CI/CD integration with S3 upload
  inventag --accounts-file accounts.json --create-excel --s3-bucket reports-bucket --s3-key-prefix bom-reports/

  # Each step of the run (-vv or --debug for debug output)
  inventag --create-excel -v

  # Debug mode with comprehensive logging
  inventag --debug --log-file inventag-debug.log --create-excel

  # Validate AWS credentials only
  inventag --validate-credentials

  # Policies on a saved snapshot, or on a scan (see 'inventag policy --help')
  inventag policy check --snapshot state/state_<ts>.json --fail-on high
  inventag --policy policies/ --policy-fail-on high

  # Templates: list them, then use one (see 'inventag templates --help')
  inventag templates list
  inventag --template executive-summary --create-word

  # Or edit the report structure file directly
  inventag --print-default-template word > my_word_template.yaml
  inventag --create-word --word-template my_word_template.yaml
